title: Davis hired by CIA as WINPAC branch chief scientist

tellings.quote: I actually got hired by the CIA to be the branch chief science K scientist of winpack back in late 2003

plain: A physicist named Eric Davis says that in late 2003 he was hired by the CIA, the American spy agency, as chief scientist of a branch in WINPAC, a CIA unit dealing with weapons intelligence. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about it as part of his career in secret government science, which would give weight to what he says about UFOs.
